reviews.scope: Issuer releases and issuer-specific reporting in the 48 elapsed hours before each first entry. Only publications without a confirmed hour or timezone may use their verified date in either of the two preceding calendar days. Same-day date-only articles remain uncertain. Syndications are merged; publications on the same topic share an eventId.

sources.note: Used the displayed historical list and individually opened reproduced releases; Finviz is the host, not the author of issuer statements.
Indexed syndicated articles provide explicit UTC offsets. Direct page requests returned HTTP 429. Relative quote-page ages were not used for matching.
Opened public issuer reporting and compared it with indexed Yahoo syndication. Premium snippets and automatic sector/price headlines were not treated as verified full articles.
Corroborates Eastern-time publication labels for reproduced issuer releases.

limitations: This is evidence of publications found, not a complete historical news feed or proof of a price catalyst.
Issuer releases were reviewed as syndicated primary statements. Direct issuer-site access timed out and GlobeNewswire's searchable archive did not expose usable article pages in this review.
Displayed publication timestamps do not prove that the currently served article text is identical to its pre-entry version. No archived pre-entry text or first-seen capture was obtained.

The early July 29 Benzinga report and the later official release share an eventId but retain different publication times and summaries. Do not expose the 09:15 release as known before the 08:21 or 08:30 entries.
Additional issuer-specific articles or filings may exist in the windows. Unknown fields and inaccessible sources remain explicit rather than becoming a no-news label.
Date-only matching is explicitly a fallback, not a claim of an exact 48-hour age. Known timestamps always retain exact elapsed-hour matching, including same-day publications before entry.

resolvedCandidates.reason: Only a publication date was established. The July 24 window begins July 22 at 10:27:29 ET, so eligibility cannot be confirmed. The underlying SEC filing was published July 21 and must not be re-dated to July 22.
resolvedCandidates.resolution: Included using the verified publication date under the user-authorized two-day fallback; exact hour remains unknown.
